summary: Syntactically valid, runs end-to-end, and implements a workable agent-based mask adoption simulation with social influence, policy, media, and supply dynamics. However, there are several deviations from the provided specification, a notable logic bug in public-space mobility under mandates, and some missing/placeholder metrics.

issues.description: Public-space attendance ignores mandates due to a hardcoded mandate_active = False in _attend_locations_today, so mobility reduction under mandates never applies.
issues.solution: Pass the actual policy state into _attend_locations_today (e.g., an argument mandate_active) or store the current policy state on the Simulation instance, and use that to compute public-space attendance probability.

issues.description: RiskEnvironment entity is not implemented as per the spec; risk feedback is handled internally via _update_risk_signal without a dedicated class.
issues.solution: Implement a RiskEnvironment class with base_risk_index and prevalence_trend, and methods to update and broadcast the risk signal, then integrate it into Simulation instead of the ad-hoc _update_risk_signal.

issues.description: Some requested metrics are missing or placeholders: supply_shortage_days and information_impact are not computed meaningfully.
issues.solution: Track daily retailer stockouts and unmet demand to compute supply_shortage_days. Capture and vary information campaign intensity and misinformation exposure to compute elasticities for information_impact.

issues.description: Restock interval parameter from spec (restock_interval_days) is not used; retailers restock daily regardless.
issues.solution: Add logic to restock only on specified intervals; e.g., track day and apply restocking when day % restock_interval_days == 0.

issues.description: Daily contact parameters (daily_contacts_home/work/community) from spec are not used; a separate contact_rate_by_location mapping is used instead.
issues.solution: Map spec parameters daily_contacts_home/work/community into contact_rate_by_location, or read them directly from cfg to drive contacts.

issues.description: Household behaviors purchase_masks_in_bulk and allocate_masks_to_members are not implemented.
issues.solution: Implement bulk purchasing at household level and distribution of masks among members to better represent shared resources.

issues.description: Results do not include time_to_threshold metrics for 70% and 90% as specified; only 50% is returned.
issues.solution: Track and return time_to_reach_70_percent and time_to_reach_90_percent, similar to time_to_reach_50_percent.

issues.description: Config mapping for rewiring probability uses rewiring_prob_small_world, but defaults and examples pass rewire_prob, which is ignored.
issues.solution: Map rewire_prob to rewiring_prob_small_world in _normalize_config or unify parameter naming.

issues.description: Person.susceptibility_to_social_influence is not used in the decision function; social influence weight is global only.
issues.solution: Multiply peer weight by individual susceptibility (e.g., effective_peer_w = peer_w * self.susceptibility_to_social_influence).

issues.description: Public-space attendance ignores location capacity and may overfill locations.
issues.solution: Respect capacity by capping attendee lists or sampling per-location up to capacity.

issues.description: Government lacks a policy_status attribute and explicit allocation_of_enforcement behavior as per spec.
issues.solution: Add policy_status field and a method to allocate enforcement resources across locations (e.g., varying enforcement_level per location).

issues.description: Media broadcast loops over all people each day and performs multiple small operations; for very large populations, consider vectorization or sampling.
issues.solution: Optionally pre-sample a set of recipients and/or vectorize with numpy when available.

issues.description: Retailer.rationing_limit_per_person is not used in Person.purchase_mask; the function takes a separate rationing_limit_per_person argument.
issues.solution: Default to r.rationing_limit_per_person when purchasing from a retailer, or remove the redundant parameter.

issues.description: Frequent 'pass' statements precede executable lines inside functions/classes, which is unnecessary and may confuse readers.
issues.solution: Remove redundant pass statements where code follows in the same block.

issues.description: np_rng is created but never used.
issues.solution: Use np_rng for vectorized random draws where applicable, or remove it if unneeded.
